capabilities: Drag nodes to reorganize and reparent branches
Apply layouts, themes and per-node styles
Insert note links and image embeds into labels
Switch between map and Markdown source
extras: Desktop only and requires Obsidian 1.13.0 or newer; the plugin makes no network requests and stores all settings in the vault's plugin data.
problem: Obsidian shows a Markdown outline only as text, with no way to view, style or rearrange it as a visual map.
summary: Mind map editor that turns a Markdown outline .mindmap file into an interactive, themed map with a source view.
